name: CX Leaders Forum
title: CX Annual Symposium- CX Event | CMO, CX Leaders Event and Conference | ET BrandEquity
briefReadyNote: Two unaudited problems carried over from this template's porting: (1) content.map's banner.fill targets "img.banner-bg-image", but this template's own sections/banner/index.html has no such element — the hero background is only a static inline CSS background on the <section> itself, so that fill rule is dead. (2) template.json's own title/source ("CX Annual Symposium…", cx-annual-symposium) name a different real ET BrandEquity event than "CX Leaders Forum" — the same wrong-event bleed-through making-ai-work had before being audited and fixed; this template hasn't been.

design.notes: What the editor's theme controls act on. SangBleu Versailles isn't a real Google Font (the live page's own fonts.googleapis.com link for it 404s) — it's self-hosted, declared with @font-face in theme.css, so headingFontVar still names the CSS variable the design's headings read, same shape as TECH500's. headings/buttons/cards = selectors for the heading/corner-radius controls. swatches = theme colours offered besides the template's own.

body.class: microsite product_microsite heading-style-1 color_black web_view_ et_brandequity single-header
body.classNotes: single-header is added at runtime by ET's header script on the live page, same as TECH500.

content.notes: How Create Event's content fills this template (editor-fill.js has the rule reference). from = a Create Event library id (step 3) or event (step 1). about_us_event (About ETBrandEquity.com) has no entry and keeps its own copy deliberately — same as TECH500's about-us, it's ET BrandEquity's publisher boilerplate, identical on every ET BrandEquity microsite, not event content a wizard field should own (the contact-us section's own escalation line, 'For any issues requiring immediate escalation, write to shahbaz.khan@...', is the same text verbatim on TECH500's contact-us too, confirming it's a corporate-wide escalation contact, not this event's — it stays static for the same reason within the otherwise-wizard-driven contact-us section). Every other real section below is wired to a library id, per this session's rule that genuine event content should end up wizard-variable rather than left as the export's own static copy — conventions-box and pillars didn't have an obvious 1:1 library match (an icon+title mini-block grid, and a 6-layer stack with per-card bullet lists) so they're mapped to the closest existing shapes (awaits, priorities) rather than left out: 'awaits' because conventions-box's cards are themed mini-blocks the live page itself calls out as what's in store at the event (same icon+title shape awaits already supports); 'priorities' because the pillars stack is literally this event's key discussion themes, and priorities.items[].points (the wizard's existing per-item pointer list) maps onto each stack card's own feature list via a nested list rule. The pillars/conventions-box card artwork (background photo, icon) stays the design's own decoration, same as TECH500 leaves industries' icon untouched — only the real text goes through the wizard. who-should-attend's roles have no second 'why' line in the live design, so only {t} is wired, matching TECH500's industries pattern of a title-only list. glimpses_event (gallery) used to only have a photo COUNT in the wizard (seed 'gallery': {count:0}, no way to set a real image), which meant its real carousel photos could never actually be replaced — this session extended the 'gallery' shape to also carry real items:[{url}] (create-event.html's gallery editor now takes a pasted image URL per tile, not just a counter), so glimpses_event's own real photography can now be swapped for the event's own via a genuine list rule, and disappears entirely (empty:hide) rather than showing CX's own past-edition photos when the user hasn't added any yet. faqs' real accordion (h3.accordion + div.panel flat siblings opened by a 'h3.accordion.active + .panel' CSS adjacent-sibling rule) doesn't survive the editor's list rule cloning/removing cards, so it's rebuilt on TECH500's own .faq-item/.faq-question/.faq-answer-wrap structure (identical script.js) with this event's own 4 real FAQs and colours. leaders (a slick.js quote carousel, not bundled here) is similarly rebuilt as a static responsive grid of its own real 10 quotes, mapped to 'insights'. speakers drops the live ET AJAX speaker-pagination widget (SpeakerAjaxPagination, masonry, popup bindings) that only works against the live CMS, keeping just the 5 real 'Previous Edition Speakers' cards it renders. The banner's own decorative '#ETCXAnnual' hashtag line had no wizard field to live in (hero carries title/tagline/date/location/CTAs, not a hashtag) and was dropped rather than shipped as frozen real text with no way to change it.

layout.notes: Which sections an event's own narrative order can touch. pinStart/pinEnd never move — the hero always opens the page and Contact/About-publisher always close it, matching every real ET microsite (same convention as TECH500). Everything else is free for RevampCanvas.mount()'s sectionOrder option to resequence.

sectionsNotes: repeat = the section's repeating cards for the editor's Layout items: item = selector for one card (its parent is the list), label = what the list shows for it. toggle = items that open on click (an accordion): item, the class that opens it, and the element whose aria-expanded follows.
